name: piabyss-memo
description: PiAbyss 方寸间 board tool for Pi: list/complete/reopen/update the user's notes (待办 · 速记 · 备忘 · 收集) with plan support (one-shot due dates + recurring rules that roll to the next occurrence on completion), plus a self-contained Cloudflare R2 cloud sync (engine + loopback control plane), sharing the exact same on-disk format as PiAbyss.
author: Nick12138
